title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, migration, licensing and documented controls are supported. A minor checklist inconsistency remains because the replacement policies are described in notes but have no matching controls-table rows.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap target is January CY2027.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "January CY2027"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), not GCC, GCC High or DoD.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap platforms are Android, Desktop, iOS, Mac and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Android", "Desktop", "iOS", "Mac", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap release phases are General Availability and Targeted Release.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Targeted Release"]

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: MeetingAI governs the availability of Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap and other AI features in meetings.
claims.quote: MeetingAI - controls whether Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap, and other AI features are available in meetings.

claims.claim: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.claim: The existing Copilot policy combines AI availability and whether a saved transcript is required.
claims.quote: Today, the Copilot policy combines whether AI is available in a meeting with whether a saved transcript is required.

claims.claim: The replacement policy model provides the ability to enforce Copilot off.
claims.quote: including the ability to enforce Copilot off.

claims.claim: Microsoft automatically maps existing Copilot policy values to the two replacement policies in a one-time update.
claims.quote: Microsoft will perform a one-time update mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values

claims.where: What's changing; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The mapping preserves current effective behaviour rather than resetting existing policies to parameter defaults.
claims.quote: mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values, preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators do not need to recreate existing policies.
claims.quote: Administrators do not need to recreate their policies.

claims.claim: The replacement arrives automatically without administrator action, represented by defaultState on.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations. ... Existing configurations will be mapped automatically.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride as the MeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote: ### -MeetingAI ... | Default value: | EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride |

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledNoOverride as the TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote: ### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI ... | Default value: | EnabledNoOverride |

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference warns that MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI are not fully released and have no effect yet.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The planned Teams admin center settings appear in meeting policies under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.
claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.

claims.claim: Allow AI in meetings offers On, Off but organisers can change, and Off and organisers cannot change.
claims.quote: Allow AI in meetings: On / Off, but organizers can change / Off, and organizers cannot change

claims.claim: Start transcription when AI is turned on offers On but organisers can change, On and organisers cannot change, and Off.
claims.quote: Start transcription when AI is turned on: On, but organizers can change / On, and organizers cannot change / Off

claims.claim: The existing Transcription policy remains and controls whether transcription is allowed.
claims.quote: The Transcription policy remains available and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI replaces Allow Copilot and Facilitator as an organiser meeting option.
claims.quote: Who can manage AI - replaces the existing Allow Copilot and Facilitator option and determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI is set to No one if an administrator turns Meeting AI off.
claims.quote: If an admin turns Meeting AI off, this option is set to No one.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The new Who can use AI meeting option controls which participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Start Transcription with AI lets organisers choose whether transcription starts with AI.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI.

claims.claim: Administrators can also control Start Transcription with AI through Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Administrators can also control this option through Teams admin center.

claims.claim: Organisers gain Intelligent Recap controls in meeting options.
claims.quote: Intelligent Recap controls - lets organizers decide whether an Intelligent Recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including for meetings where a transcript is not created.

claims.claim: MC1532253 was updated on 3 November 2026.
claims.quote: Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The notice targets Worldwide Targeted Release from early December to mid-December 2026.
claims.quote: Targeted Release (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early December 2026 (previously mid-November) and expect to complete by mid-December 2026 (previously early December).

claims.claim: The notice targets Worldwide General Availability from early January to mid-January 2027.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by mid-January 2027 (previously early December 2026).

claims.claim: The supplied notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance guidance; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Once the new controls are enabled, direct updates to the Copilot policy are rejected with guidance to use the replacement policies.
claims.quote: Once the new controls are enabled, the Copilot policy can no longer be updated directly - attempts will return guidance to use the new policies.

claims.claim: The notice says the change does not alter how existing customer data is processed or stored.
claims.quote: does not alter how existing customer data is processed or stored.

claims.claim: Organisers can decide whether transcription starts per meeting when the configured option allows their override.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI. ... On, but organizers can change / On, and organizers cannot change / Off

claims.claim: Apps receive no Work IQ transcript when Allow AI in all meetings is Off, regardless of the Work IQ access setting.
claims.quote: | Allow AI in all meetings | Work IQ access | Result | ... | Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |

claims.claim: The supplied notice describes no change to identity, permissions or roles.
claims.quote: This change affects administrative controls over AI and transcription availability in meetings

claims.claim: Teams Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and PowerShell.
claims.quote: Teams Administrator ... Everything in the Microsoft Teams admin center and associated PowerShell controls, including: ... Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.

claims.claim: Teams Communications Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and PowerShell.
claims.quote: Teams Communications Administrator ... Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges. ... PowerShell - Microsoft Teams module ... Microsoft Teams admin center

claims.claim: No separate role requirement is stated for the new parameters.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI licensing price meter role Who can use AI admin control. Opened using-admin-roles and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; neither gives a separate role requirement for these parameters.

claims.claim: Transcription can start automatically when AI is turned on, without a separate organiser action to start transcription.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Setting MeetingAI to enforced off also turns transcription off.
claims.quote: if MeetingAI is set to enforced off, transcription will also be turned off

claims.claim: Turning transcription back on means MeetingAI is no longer enforced off.
claims.quote: if transcription is then turned back on, MeetingAI will no longer be enforced off.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: These Teams policy settings take the product's included entitlement, with Teams licensed through qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or a standalone Teams SKU.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams can be licensed as part of qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or as a standalone SKU.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate licence requirement for the replacement policy settings is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI licensing price meter; TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams licensing. Opened Teams service description, copilot-teams-transcription and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no separate policy-setting licence found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Manage Teams meeting transcription lists an add-on Microsoft Copilot licence for intended users as its prerequisite.
claims.quote:
## Prerequisites

- An add-on Microsoft Copilot license for intended users.

claims.claim: No separate meter is documented for the replacement settings.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI licensing price meter; MeetingAI license price. Opened Teams service description, copilot-teams-transcription and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no setting-specific meter found.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap record nor MC1532253 mentions a charge for the policy replacement.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations.

claims.claim: The notice names Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) as its services.
claims.quote: Services: Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

claims.claim: Copilot meeting policies can be applied to groups.
claims.quote: You can apply your Copilot meeting policies to groups or individual users.

claims.claim: Meeting policies can be applied to individual users.
claims.quote: You can apply your Copilot meeting policies to groups or individual users.

claims.claim: Copilot in Teams meetings and events is not available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events isn't available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.

claims.claim: The precise reach of MeetingAI into post-meeting experiences is not detailed beyond the roadmap description.
claims.quote: Searched: MeetingAI Teams admin center post-meeting AllowIntelligentRecap. Read MC1532253, roadmap record, MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI reference sections and intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts; no complete post-meeting reach specified.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI must be used together.
claims.quote: This parameter must be used together with -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI. ... This parameter must be used together with -MeetingAI.

claims.claim: The current Copilot policy has the four listed On, saved-transcript-required, transcript-saved-by-default and Off values.
claims.quote: On | Enabled ... On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript ... On with transcript saved by default | EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn ... Off | Disabled

claims.claim: The current Copilot setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot accepts Enabled, EnabledWithTranscript, EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn and Disabled on the cited feature page.
claims.quote: The following table shows the behaviors of the settings for the -Copilot parameter: ... Enabled ... EnabledWithTranscript ... EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn ... Disabled

claims.claim: The transcription policy can be managed in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription.
claims.quote: You can use the Recording & Transcription section in the Teams admin center or the -AllowTranscription parameter ... to manage your transcription policy.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription <$true|$false> controls transcription permission.
claims.quote:
### -AllowTranscription

Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: An admin UI control equivalent to AllowIntelligentRecap is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowIntelligentRecap disable intelligent recap Teams admin center toggle policy. Opened intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; disable instructions give PowerShell, not an admin UI toggle.

claims.claim: The cited feature page documents Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false to disable recap.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.

claims.claim: The recap feature page says turning recap off disables it for all meetings, with or without saved transcripts.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.claim: The recap feature page says turning intelligent recap off makes related settings unavailable in Teams.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved, and the related settings are unavailable in Teams.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference still warns that AllowIntelligentRecap is not fully released and has no effect, disagreeing with the feature page.
claims.quote:
### -AllowIntelligentRecap

Note

This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. Controls whether Intelligent Recap is allowed for the user's meetings.

claims.claim: Work IQ access is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables the tenant Work IQ real-time transcript access setting.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default.
claims.quote: The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can. It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.claim: EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess requires the latest Teams PowerShell module version.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet give the complete new admin navigation path for MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings policy navigation; MeetingAI Teams admin center post-meeting AllowIntelligentRecap. Opened copilot-teams-transcription and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no complete new UI route.

claims.claim: The combined command names the documented MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameters and their permitted values.
claims.quote:
Possible values are:

- EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledNoOverride ... Possible values are:

- EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- EnabledNoOverride

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference lists only Enabled and EnabledWithTranscript for Copilot, unlike the four-value feature page.
claims.quote:
### -Copilot ... Possible values are:

- Enabled
- EnabledWithTranscript

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The notice names no administrator control over the Who can use AI organiser option.
claims.quote: Searched: Who can use AI admin Teams; Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings policy navigation. Read MC1532253 and copilot-teams-transcription; no separate admin control for this participant-selection option found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the interaction between AllowIntelligentRecap and MeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: MeetingAI Teams admin center post-meeting AllowIntelligentRecap. Read both parameter sections in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy, intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and MC1532253; no interaction rule for this pair found.

claims.quote: Review any automation or scripts that read or update the Copilot meeting policy, and update them to use MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends confirming that the mapped configuration reflects intended behaviour after the controls become available.
claims.quote: Confirm the mapped configuration reflects intended behavior once the new controls are available.

claims.claim: Microsoft has already moved the rollout dates.
claims.quote: early December 2026 (previously mid-November) ... early January 2027 (previously late November 2026)

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, At rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to decide, compare and test replacement-policy settings that do not appear in the controls table.
claims.quote: Decide, per policy, whether organisers may override the AI and transcription settings ... not as table rows. ... Compare each policy's mapped MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values ... Test a policy where Copilot is enforced off
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Decide, per policy', the At rollout bullet beginning 'Compare each policy', and the After rollout bullet beginning 'Test a policy'. The replacement-policy descriptions and migration recommendations can remain in the prose; noting missing table rows does not satisfy the checklist/table consistency rule.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI is a per-meeting organiser option deciding who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during the meeting.
claims.quote: Who can manage AI - replaces the existing Allow Copilot and Facilitator option and determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.
